g.text: One role field; new users are BUYER.
No disjoint Buyer/Seller subclasses or client staff selector.
Exactly one RELEASE or REFUND, never both.
Wallet, bank withdrawal and provider transfers are deferred.
Atomic issue with PASS/MINOR_ISSUE before Buyer decision.
Revocation changes certificate validity, not settlement.
item / shipping / inspection / commission : Decimal snapshots
Target logical design, not proof that baseline implements every class.
Task 02 maps these concepts to existing physical models/routes.
